# Darwinbox | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Cloud HCM for enterprises with over 1,000 people, covering core HR, talent, pay, staff experience and AI. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Implementation, relocation and change management workloads are high; local pay depth in Hong Kong needs proof; AI Cortex is an evolving product and should be certified for delivery. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The implementation, relocation and change management workload is high; the local pay depth of Hong Kong needs to be proven; AI Cortex is an evolving product and should be certified for delivery. |
